text:
Alex Kim: FYI PR #18321 is blocked — buildkite job `model-serve-integ` failed on azure-gpu-2 (gpunode-9). Failing test: `serve_pipeline_integration.TestLatencyBudget`. Can't repro locally. Anyone seen this flake recently?

ci-bot: buildkite #4812 — model-serve-integ — FAILED

Step: run-integration-tests
Exit code: 1
Logs: https://ci.redwood/4812/artifacts/serv... (truncated)

```txt
AssertionError: latency > 500ms (observed 812ms)
at tests/serve/test_latency.py:48
```

Priya Rao: @Alex Kim thanks — saw one similar on Thursday on `gpunode-7`, looked thermal throttling-ish. Could you paste the job env (CC_GPU, CUDA)?

Alex Kim: Here: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0`, `CC_GPU=rtx-a6000`, `MODEL_SEED=42`. The job archived the node label gpunode-9. Not sure about temp metrics.

Samir Patel: I can repro a tiny slowdown if I run the full suite with `--stress-cpu` in a loop; might be noisy infra. Quick check: can someone trigger a targeted rerun on that node? `ci-bot rerun --job 4812 --node gpunode-9`

infra-oncall: @Samir Patel I don't have an API to pin reruns to a specific node from cloud; can reboot the instance. Want me to recycle gpunode-9 now?

Jamie Liao: If it's infra noise we should avoid approving merge until we confirm. Option: can we add a flake-ignored tag on the test and file follow-up ticket? :thinking_face:

Alex Kim: I'd prefer to avoid test skips. Plan: infra reboot, rerun, if it passes we merge. If it fails again I'll open a short-lived canary PR that runs stress harness and we triage. Can infra reboot?

infra-oncall: Reboot started on gpunode-9 — ETA 3m. I'll post when it's back up.

ci-bot: Reboot complete. Node gpunode-9 marked healthy.

Samir Patel: Kicked off a targeted rerun: `ci-bot rerun --job 4812 --target gpunode-9`

ci-bot: Rerun #4813 queued -> running on gpunode-9.

ci-bot: Rerun #4813 — PASSED ✅

Alex Kim: Nice — thanks infra/oncall & Samir. Anyone ok to approve merge? This PR touches the serving optimizer and we'd like to get it in today's release window.

Priya Rao: Looks fine to me. :+1: Approving now.

Jamie Liao: Approved. @Alex Kim make a post-merge ticket to monitor latency 24h and revert if regressions.

Alex Kim: Will do. Filing ticket: RW-2107 to track 24h latency baseline and add CI stress job. Merging now.

ci-bot: Merged PR #18321 into main by Alex Kim.
